scope: User-approved source-role audit, not production activation. Complete main price tuple from BaoStock only; BaoStock dated trading/ST facts; Eastmoney stock/get price and supplied limits together; Tushare remains optional v1 fallback with its own identity.
rules: Preserve v1/v2 protocols, artifacts and incomplete verdicts. Preserve numeric thresholds and dates. Previously inspected three companion samples are exploratory, never blind validation.

Validate BaoStock daily frequency d, adjustflag 3, exact code/date/batch and actual observation time. Open/high/low/close/preclose/volume/amount must be from one original daily query, finite and internally consistent. Missing OHLC is not silently filled from another supplier.

Validate matching baseline close/preclose within 0.005. Baseline is an immutable historical cross-check, not the assembled main price source. If baseline OHLC exists, compare it as a separate diagnostic.
Suspension/ST retain v2 explicit-state, positive-volume, conflict and fail-closed rules. Do not license optional Tushare fallback by giving it a new source identity.

Use Eastmoney stock/get raw f57 code, f59=2 scale, f43 price, f60 prior close, f51 upper price, f52 lower price, f86 aware same-session after-close timestamp. Decode price and both limits from this one response. Require rc=0, exact symbol, positive finite prices, lower <= last <= upper and lower < upper.

Cross-check Eastmoney last/preclose against the same-date BaoStock close/preclose within 0.005, source receipt no later than audit time, and original evidence hashes. Missing or mismatched source prices/date/batch/scale mean limit states None, not safe False.

Equality of Eastmoney last and its upper/lower supplied bound determines daily limit state. No theoretical 10/20 percent rule and no guessed ordinary-regime proof for these supplied bounds. Zero/absent bounds or unsupported boards remain None.
Do not infer historical state from current undated names. Historical acquisition retains real acquisition timestamps. No current data reconstructs missing historical companion observations.

No new source calls without the existing owner-host BaoStock guard, official blacklist check and shared message budget. Login/logout, pagination and failures all count. Cached companion replay needs no new requests.
comparison: Report whole original universe and all frozen dates, not only three probe stocks. Small audited overlap is not acceptance.
Preserve mandatory companion and AKShare dated pool checks. Pool membership proves True only; absence never proves False.
Primary BaoStock ST/suspension or primary companion limit output cannot validate itself. Same-source reference rows are counted as ignored, not independent coverage or agreement.
Cross-supplier price agreement proves price consistency only, not independent confirmation of all risk fields. Missing positive examples or historical reference coverage means incomplete.
No mismatched/unknown row may be promoted to a formal list. Show evidence for user confirmation before any exact scenario licensing.
activation: No license or production consumer change in this audit. Only after real acceptance and explicit user confirmation: integration/tests, full verification/release, main merge and backed-up plugin-only reload.
